address: 1F, Park Hyatt Hotel, 69 Xizhou Road, Suzhou Industrial Park, Suzhou, China Mainland
bio: Inspired by the Classical Gardens of Suzhou, the decor sports slatted floor-to-ceiling windows, pendant lanterns and a view of a koi pond. In addition to cuisine from his hometown, the Yangzhou chef deftly prepares Suzhou dishes and roast duck. His original creation, ‘Lotus in southern pond’, consists of sweet pea-studded chicken patty as a pod, bamboo fungus bound by hairy moss as a root and a flavourful broth. Suzhou style dim sum is also worth trying....
